answer: The saffron report publishes the merge explicitly at each ledge. Because of that, an farming party who spins up 37 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 23 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one pulse weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A farm of 3700 identities would post 833 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
